may_inbound_pedestrians.label: measured
may_inbound_pedestrians.means: pedestrians recorded ENTERING the United States at the Progreso port of entry in May 2026. It is not a count of the people the cameras watched, who were walking the other way.

outbound_series_months.label: measured
outbound_series_months.means: months of published federal outbound pedestrian counts at this port. The dataset's own description states no comparable data is collected on outbound crossings.

performance_facts_asked.label: measured
performance_facts_asked.means: performance facts a reader would need, each one established as absent by its own claim: an accuracy, match or error rate; a count of images captured; a retention period for the images; a decision to deploy; a date range for the assessment

characterisations_quoted.label: measured
characterisations_quoted.means: quotations the account publishes about how the test went, each one a characterisation rather than a measurement: exceeded expectations, said by CBP's Biometrics Program Office; high-quality facial images, said by the president of NEC NSS; and it did just that, the line that closes the division director's quotation

performance_facts_published.label: measured
performance_facts_published.means: how many of those five the account publishes.

claims_verified.label: measured
claims_verified.means: claims this run fetched and verified, counted over claims.json. The site's article page prints this count beside the list it renders.

findings_rejected.label: measured
findings_rejected.means: scout findings the fact check refused, counted over claims.json's rejected list. Each carries its own reason in that file.

months_request_to_account.label: measured
months_request_to_account.means: whole months from the month CBP asked to the month the account published.

months_bridge_to_account.label: measured
months_bridge_to_account.means: whole months from the month the partners were at the bridge to the month the account published.

days_to_dallas.label: measured
days_to_dallas.means: days from this run's date to the Dallas briefing.

absences.what: an accuracy, match or error rate
a retention period for the images
a date range for the assessment

characterisations.what: exceeded expectations, said by CBP's Biometrics Program Office
high-quality facial images, said by the president of NEC NSS
and it did just that, the line that closes the division director's quotation
